name: Chest pain
must_know: Immediate ACS rule-out: ECG within 10 minutes of arrival; aspirin 300 mg unless contraindicated; 000/ED transfer if suspected ACS. Discriminate GORD, musculoskeletal, PE, pericarditis, aortic dissection.
should_know: Tropinin pathways and safe rule-out; when CT coronary angiography is appropriate; PE risk scores.
nice_to_know: Aortic dissection risk scores; pericarditis ECG changes.

name: Tiredness / fatigue
must_know: Screen for depression, sleep, alcohol, anaemia, diabetes, hypothyroid, coeliac, meds. Targeted first-line tests: FBE, UEC, LFT, TSH, ferritin, BGL/HbA1c, CRP if inflammatory cause suspected.
should_know: When to add B12, folate, coeliac serology, EBV/other infective screen; chronic fatigue syndrome criteria and management.

name: Headache
must_know: Red flags: thunderclap sudden onset, fever/neck stiffness, papilloedema/focal neurology, new headache >50y, GCA features >50y, medication-overuse. Primary headaches: migraine, tension, cluster.
should_know: Migraine acute and prophylactic management (Australian choices); GCA workup (ESR/CRP, urgent steroid, temporal artery); benign intracranial hypertension.

name: Dizziness / vertigo
must_know: Separate peripheral (BPPV, vestibular neuronitis) from central (stroke, MS). HINTS exam. Dix-Hallpike for BPPV + Epley. Postural BP in older patients on antihypertensives.
should_know: Vestibular migraine; Red flags requiring urgent neuroimaging (acute persistent, neuro signs, inability to walk).

name: Abdominal pain
must_know: Surgical abdomen signs; discriminate biliary, appendicitis, diverticulitis, renal colic, gynae (ectopic in women of reproductive age - always consider pregnancy), mesenteric ischaemia in elderly.
should_know: Chronic: IBS criteria, coeliac, IBD red flags, cancer (change in bowel habit, PR bleeding).

name: Dyspnoea
must_know: Immediate: asthma, COPD exacerbation, heart failure, PE, pneumothorax, pneumonia. Examination triage: respiratory distress, SpO2, accessory muscles. When to send to ED.
should_know: Chronic causes: interstitial disease, anaemia, deconditioning, anxiety. BNP role.

name: Cough
must_know: Duration drives workup: acute (URTI, bronchitis, pneumonia, pertussis); chronic >4 weeks (post-infectious, asthma, GORD, upper airway cough syndrome, ACE inhibitor, lung cancer in smokers). Red flags: haemoptysis, weight loss, smoker.
should_know: Pertussis testing and public health notification; when CXR.

name: Weight loss
must_know: Malignancy, hyperthyroid, depression/dementia in elderly, diabetes, coeliac, TB. Red flags: >5% body weight in 6 months, dysphagia, PR bleeding, night sweats. Structured workup; consider malignancy review.
should_know: Elder safe assessment: eat/walk/dementia; sarcopenia vs cachexia.

name: Fever in adults
must_know: Common viral vs bacterial; focal exam; when blood cultures before antibiotics; sepsis recognition (qSOFA); immunosuppressed febrile patient = urgent ED.
should_know: Q fever/leptospirosis risk occupations (QLD farmers, abbatoir workers); returned traveller fever (malaria risk - urgent if falciparum zone).

name: Rash
must_know: Life-threatening: meningococcal (petechiae + fever = ED), SJS/TEN, necrotising fasciitis, eczema herpeticum. Common: urticaria, dermatitis, psoriasis, tinea, drug eruption.
should_know: Describe lesions formally (morphology, distribution); biopsy rules; photosensitivity; melanoma ABCD + ugly duckling.

name: Joint pain
must_know: Inflammatory pattern: morning stiffness >60 min, swelling, small joints. Septic arthritis = joint aspiration same day (ED) - do not start antibiotics before aspiration. Gout acute treatment. New RA - early referral.
should_know: Osteoarthritis non-surgical ladder; safe NSAID use; PMR >50 with shoulder/hip girdle pain + ESR.

name: Back pain
must_know: Red flags: cauda equina (saddle anaesthesia, urinary retention - ED), cancer history, fever (discitis), weight loss, trauma. Most acute low back pain: stay active, no imaging in first 4-6 weeks.
should_know: Radicular pain and radiculopathy management; when physio; chronic pain pathway.

name: Abnormal blood tests
must_know: Anaemia, high/low platelets, high WCC, high ESR/CRP, abnormal LFTs, eGFR decline: each needs structured interpretation, repeat/confirm, and a clear next step. Do not discharge or ignore persistent unexplained abnormal results - investigate or refer.
should_know: Incidental thrombocytosis (iron deficiency, inflammation); monoclonal protein/paraprotein - haematology referral.

name: Abnormal liver function tests
must_know: Pattern: hepatocellular (ALT) vs cholestatic (ALP+GGT). Common: NAFLD, alcohol, drugs. Screen: repeat LFT, viral serology (Hep B/C), ferritin, autoimmune (ANA/ASMA), ultrasound. ALP isolated high: check GGT; bone source.
should_know: When to refer; fatty liver monitoring; hepatotoxic meds (amoxiclav, statins).
nice_to_know: Gilbert syndrome; Wilson disease in young.

name: Anaemia
must_know: Microcytic (iron deficiency - always find cause in adults: coeliac, malignancy esp. bowel; men and postmenopausal women need GI workup) vs macrocytic (B12/folate, alcohol, hypothyroid) vs normocytic (CKD, anaemia of chronic disease).
should_know: Ferritin optimal >30 (some use >50 with inflammation); anaemia in pregnancy; reticulocytes.

name: Haematuria
must_know: Visible haematuria in >40s: exclude malignancy - urgent urology/CT urogram; glomerular (dysmorphic RBC/proteinuria) vs urological. UTI treatment before re-testing after infection.
should_know: IgA nephropathy; thin basement membrane; ACR role.

name: Child with fever
must_know: Infant <3 months with fever = urgent hospital referral. Traffic light (NICE/RCH): green - manage, amber - review 24h, red - refer. Fever without focus; petechial rash = ED; meningococcal signs in children.
should_know: Fever duration and urine testing in young children; Kawasaki features (fever >5 days + red eyes, mucositis).

name: Pregnancy-related presentations
must_know: First trimester bleeding/pain: ectopic must be excluded (quantitative bhCG, ultrasound). BP >=140/90 in pregnancy = review same day; severe headache/visual symptoms/RUQ pain = urgent obstetric review. Postnatal depression screen (EPDS).
should_know: Antenatal schedule; medication safety in pregnancy; hyperemesis management.

name: Behavioural concern
must_know: In children: developmental, autism, ADHD, family stress, school issues; in elderly: delirium vs dementia vs depression. Always check safety (self-harm, harm to others, child protection).
should_know: Autism referral pathways (QLD: NDIS, paediatrician); conduct disorder.

name: Screening consultation
must_know: Australian programs: cervical (25-74, 5-yearly HPV test, self-collection choice), bowel (45-74, 2-yearly iFOBT), breast (50-74 invited 2-yearly, 40+ eligible). Also: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander health checks (annual, MBS 715), 75+ health assessment, 45-49 health assessment, STI screening by risk, CVD risk assessment.
should_know: Preventive activities from Red Book (10th ed 2024); lifestyle: smoking, alcohol, activity, diet, sun; immunisation status; family history of cancer criteria.
nice_to_know: Unproven screening to avoid (whole-body scans, routine tumour markers) - Red Book lists tests NOT to do.
